title: Joypad Controller
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 015, Joypad Controller, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.
hint: Drag the joypad; release to spring back. Arrow keys work too.
css:
.d-drams-015{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:320px;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;background:#fff;color:#515151;font:400 12px/1.3 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;isolation:isolate;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .d-drams-015 *{box-sizing:border-box;font-family:inherit;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .d-drams-015 button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer} .d-drams-015 .control{position:relative;outline:none;touch-action:none;user-select:none} .d-drams-015 .control:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa651f66;outline-offset:10px;border-radius:50%} .d-drams-015 .sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)} .d-drams-015 .disc{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;inset:0;will-change:transform} .d-drams-015 .white-disc{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f8f8f8,#e6e6e6);box-shadow:inset 1px 2px 3px #fff,inset -1px -2px 3px #d9d9d9,9px 12px 15px #00000026,2px 3px 3px #0000001a} .d-drams-015 .orange-dot{position:absolute;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fb641f} .d-drams-015 .mark{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;font-size:13px;line-height:1;color:#555;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)} .d-drams-015 .sphere{border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 31% 23%,#fff 0%,#f5f5f5 17%,#dfdfdf 47%,#a4a4a4 93%);box-shadow:inset 1px 2px 3px #fff7,0 9px 12px #00000016} .d-drams-015 .sphere:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:45%;top:45%;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff651f} .d-drams-015 button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa651f66;outline-offset:5px}
.d-drams-015 .joy-base{width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;background:#d8d8d8;padding:12px}.d-drams-015 .joy-rim{width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;padding:11px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff 6%,#ccc 30%,#333 72%,#111);border:2px solid #777;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 2px #fff8,6px 7px 12px #0003}.d-drams-015 .joy-disc{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #f0f0f0;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fafafa,#e5e5e5);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 3px #cfcfcf,1px 1px 5px #0002;transform:translate(var(--x,0px),var(--y,0px));transition:transform .16s cubic-bezier(.2,1.7,.5,1);cursor:grab}.d-drams-015 .joy-disc i{position:absolute;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#ddd;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #fff}.d-drams-015 .up{left:21px;top:4px}.d-drams-015 .down{left:21px;bottom:4px}.d-drams-015 .left{top:21px;left:4px}.d-drams-015 .right{top:21px;right:4px}
prompt: Recreate the Joypad Controller composition from https://drams.framer.website/drams/015 as standalone HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a native 300 by 320 white stage. Preserve its proportions, gentle physical materials, interaction states and keyboard access. Use locally bundled Inter for labels and tabular numerical values. Drag the joypad; release to spring back. Arrow keys work too.
